title: Chosen with Care
caption:
My everyday edit is a short one.

Quality is never in question.
But owning too much, wearing too much —
that has never felt right to me.
I prefer to keep it simple.

Which is why the choosing matters.

A few good things,
used with care and the right technique,
are all a face really needs.
No reason to keep adding more.

Refinement does not come from how much you wear.
It comes from what you choose.

In the end, it is all in the choosing.
